_notes: Tolerances for `npm run eval:gate`. A metric may move by this much (absolute) in the WORSE direction before the gate fails.
The corpus is fixed and Trace is deterministic, so any movement is real; tolerances exist only to allow a deliberate, reviewed trade-off (e.g. +0.3 points of wrong-accepts for +8 points of recall).
Change a tolerance in the same commit as the algorithm change that needs it, with the reason in the commit message.
headline = every certain part in the committed corpus. category = the same metric within one category (small n, so looser).

knownDrift.why: src/match.mjs findEndpoints() takes the FIRST list-like GET, so with two candidate endpoints the ORDER of `apis` is an input. Recorded as a known weakness (question form: which endpoint), not hidden. Any other order dependence still fails the gate.
